description: A trap: a deploy shipped and the raw health numbers rose after it (cron failures 3->5, webhook dead-letters 2->3), so it LOOKS like a regression - but every delta is below the absolute+ratio thresholds, so the comparison is within-tolerance noise and the verdict is clean. Correct behavior: emit the clean all-clear finding naming the from->to SHAs and do NOTHING - no regression file_task (no threshold breach) and no run_smoke re-verify (that is only authorized on a real regression).

memo.summary: Deploy eeee5555->7777aaaa verified clean - no health regression.
